name: Zone 1
buildingName: LBNL SDAHU - Coil Valve Leak Case

faults.summary: Chilled water valve leaking by when it should be shut
faults.explanation: CHWC_VLV (the chilled water coil valve's actual position) sits around 10% open even though CHWC_VLV_DM (the commanded position) is 0%. A small amount of chilled water keeps passing through, quietly cooling the supply air and wasting energy while the coil appears fully closed.
